_about: Day 3, Task 2: hand labels for 34 regex-typed relationships (all 3 OVERRULES, all 4 DISTINGUISHES, 15 random FOLLOWS, 12 random INTERPRETS; seed 11), made by Claude (an AI model, not a person) from the evidence sentence BEFORE the LLM check was run. Precedent links: FOLLOWS (the court relies on / applies it), DISTINGUISHES (the court finds it does not apply), OVERRULES (this court declares it wrong / no longer good law), CITES (neutral, or relied on by counsel or by the court below). Provision links: INTERPRETS (the court explains meaning or scope) or REFERS_TO.
